findings: IMPLEMENTED display-name edit (PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/name). SERVICE: new export renameModelDisplayName(user: AuthUser, modelName: string, rawName: string): Promise<LanguageModelMetadata> in services/language-model-service.ts. Order mirrors session rename but adds team isolation: (1) checkLanguageModelAccess(user, modelName) -> returns metadata, 404 when missing/PENDING/other-team (reused FEAT-002 helper, now imported from access-control-service alongside checkSessionAccess); (2) requireRole(user,'TEAM_LEADER') (REVIEWER -> 403); (3) trim rawName, reject empty ('Display name is required.') and out-of-range ('Display name must be between 1 and 100 characters.') using the shared DISPLAY_NAME_MIN=1/MAX=100 constants; (4) within-team uniqueness via findByDisplayName(model.teamId, newLower), excluding self (existing && existing.modelName !== model.modelName -> VALIDATION_ERROR 400, Japanese message reused from create); (5) updateDisplayName(modelName, displayName, displayNameLower) (repo rewrites displayName/displayNameLower + GSI2SK); returns { ...model, displayName, displayNameLower }. Added import updateDisplayName from language-model-repository.js. HANDLER: new handlers/patch-language-model-name.ts (JSDoc 'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/name', one handler per file, named export). Mirrors patch-session-name.ts: extractUser; require modelName path param (400); body { name:string } required (400); calls renameModelDisplayName; records LANGUAGE_MODEL_NAME_CHANGED audit (resourceType 'LanguageModel', resourceId=modelName, metadata { displayName }); successResponse({ data: updated }); inner try/catch rethrows AppError (has statusCode) else internalError('モデル表示名の更新に失敗しました。'). Passes raw (untrimmed) name to the service (service trims). TESTS: language-model-service.test.ts — added renameModelDisplayName describe (8 cases: unique rename persists, trims, self-name allowed, duplicate->400, REVIEWER->403, whitespace->400, >100->400, inaccessible->404); updated access-control-service mock to include checkLanguageModelAccess and repo mock to include updateDisplayName. patch-language-model-name.test.ts — new, mirrors patch-session-name.test.ts (success+audit, raw passthrough, missing param/body/name 400s, service-thrown 400/404/403, raw error->500). PROPERTY TEST: language-model-service.property.test.ts — added 'Feature: language-model-team-isolation, Property 5: within-team displayName uniqueness on rename' (fast-check numRuns 100), docstring **Validates: 新規要件 — カスタム言語モデルの表示名編集** (design.md 表示名編集 / displayName チーム内一意). Three properties: reject rename to a name used by ANOTHER model in the same team (asserts findByDisplayName scoped to model.teamId, updateDisplayName not called); allow renaming to the model's OWN current name (self excluded); allow a name used only in OTHER teams (own-team lookup returns null -> rename proceeds). Extended that file's access-control mock (checkLanguageModelAccess) + repo mock (updateDisplayName). INFRA: api-stack.ts — added patchLanguageModelNameFn = createLambda('PatchLanguageModelName', { entry: handlersDir, description:'PATCH /language-models/{modelName}/name - Rename model display name', environment: commonEnv }); grants grantDynamoDbReadWrite + grantKmsAccess ONLY (NO Transcribe) — matches 'DynamoDB + KMS only' requirement (verified in snapshot: policy has xray + dynamodb + kms only). addRoute('PATCH','/language-models/{modelName}/name', patchLanguageModelNameFn, jwtAuthorizer) placed right after GET /language-models/{modelName}. SNAPSHOT: regenerated infra/test/__snapshots__/api-stack.test.ts.snap intentionally with `npx vitest --run test/api-stack.test.ts -u`; git diff is +222 lines, 0 deletions, all for the new PatchLanguageModelName Lambda/role/policy/log-group + PATCH route/integration/permission. VERIFICATION: backend `npx vitest --run` => 1210 passed / 85 skipped, 0 failed. infra `npx vitest --run` => foundation-stack + api-stack green; the 2 cdn-stack snapshot failures are PRE-EXISTING and UNRELATED (documented in FEAT-001 findings: CDK-provided custom-resource inline-asset whitespace drift; cdn-stack.ts untouched by FEAT-003). `npx cdk diff --all` synthesizes cleanly (bundles all assets; new PatchLanguageModelName resources present; live diff N/A with no AWS creds — same as FEAT-001/002).
